summary: Round 2 (fix commit 95a82ca, scoped to src/data/migration.ts and tests/unit/migration.test.ts). Finding 1 is fixed correctly: the single `.replace(/[\s\uD800-\uDBFF]+$/, '')` strips whitespace and lone high surrogates together. Verified: the old chain returns 199 chars ending in \uD83D on 'a'*198 + '\uD83D' + ' tail', while the new chain returns 198. Valid pairs survive, including 'a'*197 + emoji + ' x' -> '...a' + emoji. A 200k-case random fuzz found no non-idempotent, untrimmed or surrogate-terminated result. The new assertions fail on the targeted bugs: the old chain fails both the 198-length expectation and the second-pass check. Dropping the `!Array.isArray` guard in isObject makes taskObjects mutate the array element in place, which fails `not.toHaveProperty('followUps')` for both v8 and v9 inputs (makeTask creates no followUps by default). Finding 3 is therefore fixed. Finding 2 was deferred by an accepted escalation. As of this review, 0012-feat-follow-up-tasks-decisions.md has no entry for it yet, so make sure it gets recorded before Task 03 starts. No regressions: 52/52 tests pass and tsc --noEmit is clean.
